spec.title: Network Observability - Interface and Path Performance
spec.description: Interface throughput, utilisation, errors and link state across the server fleet, plus end-to-end path reachability and latency from the external probes.

options.content:
Interface and path performance

Per-interface throughput, utilisation, errors and link state across the server fleet, and end-to-end reachability and latency from the external probes. Live summary of the current selection.

Hosts reporting{{data.[0].[0].[Value #A]}}{{data.[1].[0].[Value #B]}} interfaces tracked
Interfaces up{{data.[2].[0].[Value #C]}} / {{data.[3].[0].[Value #D]}}operstate reported by the host
Total throughput{{data.[4].[0].[Value #E]}}in + out, all selected interfaces
Checks passing{{#if data.[6].[0].[Value #G]}}{{data.[5].[0].[Value #F]}} / {{data.[6].[0].[Value #G]}}external probe checks{{else}}-awaiting probe results{{/if}}
options.defaultContent:
Interface and path performance

Awaiting data for the current selection.

panels.title: Inbound
panels.description: Aggregate receive rate across the selected interfaces.

panels.title: Outbound
panels.description: Aggregate transmit rate across the selected interfaces.

panels.title: Peak interface utilisation
panels.description: Busiest interface by receive rate against its negotiated link speed (node_network_speed_bytes).

panels.title: Errors and drops
panels.description: Interface errors plus drops per second, both directions.

panels.title: Packets per second
panels.description: Receive plus transmit packet rate across the selected interfaces.

panels.title: Interfaces up
panels.description: Share of interfaces with operstate up (node_network_up).

panels.title: Throughput in and out per interface
panels.description: Receive rate above the axis, transmit rate mirrored below. Driven by rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total / node_network_transmit_bytes_total) x 8, plus windows_net_bytes_received_total / windows_net_bytes_sent_total for Windows hosts (all NICs of the selected hosts).

panels.title: Link utilisation
panels.description: Percent of negotiated link speed in use, where node_network_speed_bytes is non-zero. Receive above the axis, transmit mirrored below.

panels.title: Errors, drops, packets and link state
Errors and drops per second
panels.description: Receive plus transmit errors (node_network_*_errs_total) and drops (node_network_*_drop_total) per second, summed over the selected interfaces. A flat zero line means clean links.

panels.title: Packets per second in and out
panels.description: Packet rate per interface, receive above the axis and transmit mirrored below.

panels.title: Link state: operstate and carrier
panels.description: node_network_up (operstate) and node_network_carrier per interface. Green is up, red is down.

panels.title: Interface inventory
panels.description: One row per interface: operstate and admin state from node_network_info, negotiated speed, MTU, live in and out rates and the current error plus drop rate.

panels.title: Utilisation per interface
panels.description: Percent of negotiated link speed in use right now, per interface and direction.

panels.title: Top interfaces by throughput
panels.description: Interfaces ranked by combined in plus out rate, with the trend over the selected window.

panels.title: Top interfaces by error rate
panels.description: Interfaces ranked by errors plus drops per second, with the trend over the selected window.

panels.title: Throughput heatmap by host
panels.description: Combined in plus out rate per host over time. Each row is a host, colour is bits per second.

panels.title: Probe success by check and region
panels.description: Success percentage of each check, split by probe region. Driven by probe_success joined to sm_check_info.

panels.title: Check state over time
panels.description: probe_success per check over time: green is passing, red is failing.

panels.title: Probe latency p50 and p95
panels.description: Latency quantiles from the probe_all_duration_seconds histogram, across the selected checks and regions, plus p95 per region.

panels.title: Probe latency distribution
panels.description: Distribution of probe durations over time from the histogram buckets of probe_all_duration_seconds.

panels.title: Check health
panels.description: One hexagon per check, coloured by current success percentage.

panels.title: Recent check results
panels.description: Latest result lines from the probe agent for the selected checks. A failed check is logged at error level with probe_success=0 on the stream.
